Compliance Officer Job at Erisco Foods Limited




        
    

        
        Erisco Foods Limited is an indigenous food product manufacturer, incorporated in Nigeria in 2004 and started operations in 2009, manufacturing Tomato Paste, Seasoning, Rice, Milk cubes and more. We are firmly committed to producing high-quality products that combine nourishment with value pricing, as they strive to become one of Nigeria’s largest indigenous foodmanufacturers on a global scale. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Compliance Officer

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are hiring a Compliance Officer to strengthen its regulatory and documentation processes.
	This role is ideal for professionals with a solid background in compliance, audit, and statutory reporting.
	The successful candidate will ensure the organization adheres to all relevant laws and internal policies.


Responsibilities


	Conduct internal compliance audits and assist in policy implementation
	Monitoring compliance with company policies and directives
	Monitoring customer acknowledgement
	Monitoring compliance with credit policy, debtors circularisation, recovery of outstanding debts and reconciliation of corporate customers' accounts
	Monitoring the inflation of product prices


Requirements


	B.Sc / HND / OND / Graduate Trainee of Accounting or Management Sciences with 2 or 3 years of experience is an added advantage.
	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Law, or a related field
	Strong analytical and documentation skills with close attention to detail
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and coordination abilities
	Ability to manage multiple compliance tasks across departments.
	The candidate must reside in Lagos State.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of the email. 

Note


	Only qualified candidate will be shortlisted.
	Candidate must reside in or around Ikeja, Ogba, or Ketu Axis.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Database Administrator",
  "description": "Moniepoint Incorporated is a global business payments and banking platform and recently became QED Investors&rsquo; first investment in Africa. We are the partner of choice for over 600,000 businesses of all sizes, powering the dreams of SMBs and providing them with equal access to the tools they need to grow and scale.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: Database Administrator

Job Location: Remote (Full time)

Job Purpose


	We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator to join our team!
	As a Database Administrator at our company, you will be responsible for designing, testing, planning, implementing, protecting, operating, managing and maintaining our company&#39;s databases.
	You will provide technical support to other team members and evaluate new database solutions and technologies, the goal is to provide a seamless flow of information throughout the company.&nbsp;


What you&rsquo;ll get to do


	Create, monitor and maintain the company&rsquo;s databases&nbsp;
	Diagnose and resolve problems quickly
	Proactively and regularly make recommendations for system improvements
	Implement and manage company data management policies
	Managing database access and permissions.
	Ensuring that databases meet users&rsquo; requirements.
	Liaise with programmers, applications/operational staff, IT project managers and other technical staff.
	Reviewing and managing database security, integrity and backup procedures and performance tuning.
	Devising and implementing processes for resolving faults and data loss.
	Writing disaster recovery plans.
	Archiving data.
	Replicating data for disaster recovery.


To succeed in this role, we think you should have


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Computer Science or a related information technology field&nbsp;
	3-5 years of experience as a Database Administrator or similar role
	Extensive knowledge of database technology, networks and server operating systems and hardware.
	Extensive experience in administering, managing and tuning databases
	Good understanding of data and schema standards and concepts
	Good understanding of database design, implementation, troubleshooting and maintenance&nbsp;
	Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience with MySQL, Cloud Spanner, BigTable and Clickhouse or other DBMS
	Meticulous attention to detail
	Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Database Administrator Job at Moniepoint

 Job Position: Database Administrator

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator to join our team!
	As a Database Administrator at our company, you will be responsible for designing, testing, planning, implementing, protecting, operating, managing and maintaining our company's databases.

	Create, monitor and maintain the company’s databases

	Proactively and regularly make recommendations for system improvements
	Implement and manage company data management policies

	Ensuring that databases meet users’ requirements.
	Liaise with programmers, applications/operational staff, IT project managers and other technical staff.
	Reviewing and managing database security, integrity and backup procedures and performance tuning.
	Devising and implementing processes for resolving faults and data loss.
	Writing disaster recovery plans.
	Archiving data.
	Replicating data for disaster recovery.

	Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related information technology field 
	3-5 years of experience as a Database Administrator or similar role
	Extensive knowledge of database technology, networks and server operating systems and hardware.
	Extensive experience in administering, managing and tuning databases
	Good understanding of data and schema standards and concepts
	Good understanding of database design, implementation, troubleshooting and maintenance 
	Expertise in SQL and hands-on experience with MySQL, Cloud Spanner, BigTable and Clickhouse or other DBMS
	Meticulous attention to detail
	Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team
